item.title: The Beaches on Accepting Global Force Award, Inspiration Behind ‘Did I Say Too Much’ | Billboard Women In Music 2026
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest from the world of music. I'm your host, and today we're taking you to the red carpet at the Billboard Women in Music 2026 event.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "We had the chance to catch up with The Beaches, a talented group that's making waves in the music industry. But that's not all - they were joined by two special guests: Drew Afualo and Lyndsey Havens from Billboard.
[Short music clip]
Host: "Lyndsey Havens, a well-known face at Billboard, brought her expertise to the conversation. And Drew Afualo, with his unique perspective, added to the excitement of the evening.
[Outro music starts]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll catch you on the next one, with more updates from the world of music."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
